burnnote.ph.text: A password, an address, something said once…
burnnote.note.once: This link opens exactly once. It is deleted from the server the moment it opens. If nobody opens it, it disappears in 7 days.
burnnote.note.warn: Opening it destroys it. Press when you are ready to write it down.
burnnote.how: Why we cannot read it: the text is locked in this browser, and the key rides after the # in the link. Browsers never send what follows # to the server.
burnnote.status.opened: Opened — this note no longer exists
burnnote.status.badkey: The key does not match — the link may have been cut short
burnnote.status.failed: Could not store it — try again shortly
burnnote.status.copyfail: Copying was blocked — please select and copy it yourself
